subject: Greenline: Demo reschedule request — Q4 spend freeze impact
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Brennan <sarah.brennan@greenline.com>
Cc: Tom Hendrix <tom.hendrix@greenline.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro demo — proposed 20 Jan / agenda attached

Sarah — great to meet you on the call last week. As discussed I set aside 45 minutes for a focused demo of Redwood’s inference runtime and cost controls. Proposed time: Wed, Jan 20 at 11:00 AM PT.

Draft agenda:
- 10 min: business context & success metrics
- 20 min: live demo (routing, batching, cost controls)
- 10 min: procurement/next steps and timelines

I’ve attached a short deck so stakeholders can quickly scan technical fit. If that time works, I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short pre-demo checklist for procurement. If not, tell me what windows look like and we’ll adjust.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
[attachment: Redwood-Demo-Deck.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Sarah Brennan <sarah.brennan@greenline.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hendrix <tom.hendrix@greenline.com>, procurement@greenline.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 15:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Intro demo — proposed 20 Jan / agenda attached

Hi Jonas — thanks for the deck and for setting this up. Quick update from our side: the CFO has put a temporary spend freeze on new vendor pilots through the end of January as we do a FY budget reset. Also, Tom will be traveling the week of the 18th and is unavailable on the 20th.

Would you be able to push the demo to the week of Feb 8–12? That should give us enough time to clear the budget item and ensure procurement can join. I’ve cc’d procurement so they can flag any required docs.

Apologies for the shuffle — we’re very interested, just constrained on timing. I’ve attached a short note from finance summarizing the freeze.

Best,
Sarah Brennan
Head of Data Strategy | Greenline Freight
sarah.brennan@greenline.com
[attachment: Greenline-Budget-Note.pdf (text/pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: (internal)
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 08:29:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Re: Intro demo — proposed 20 Jan / agenda attached

Marissa / Monica — forwarding Sarah’s update. Their CFO froze new pilots until Feb and Tom will be traveling on our original date. Implications:
- Timeline slips ~3 weeks; close timeline moves to mid-Feb if procurement approves.
- Opportunity: align demo with procurement presence so we don’t run into evidence back-and-forth later.
- Risk: budget reprioritization could shrink initial scope — we may need to offer a focused pilot SKU or a discounted PoC.

Questions: 1) Should we proactively offer a one-week free PoC credit if procurement needs that to pilot? 2) Any reason we shouldn’t propose Feb 8 or Feb 10 as alternatives?

I’ll hold off on sending external reschedule until I have your input.

Thanks,
Jonas
---
Jonas Weber | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: Re: Intro demo — proposed 20 Jan / agenda attached

Jonas — thanks for the heads-up. Quick thoughts:
- Offer a focused 2-week pilot SKU with a capped credit (we recommend $3k standard credit for pilots under $25k ARR) — keeps procurement happy and avoids long PO cycles.
- Suggest two slots: Tue Feb 8 11:00 AM PT or Thu Feb 10 9:00 AM PT. Include a 15-min pre-demo call with procurement the week before to go over SOC2/evidence.
- If finance pushes further, we can convert the credit to a time-limited discount in the SOW.

Go ahead and propose both dates to Sarah; include the pilot credit proposal and offer procurement a checklist. I’ll draft the pilot terms after we lock a date.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Brennan <sarah.brennan@greenline.com>
Cc: Tom Hendrix <tom.hendrix@greenline.com>, procurement@greenline.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 Jan 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro demo — proposed 20 Jan / agenda attached

Sarah — thanks for the update and the finance note. We completely understand. Two proposed demo slots (pick one):
- Tue, Feb 8 at 11:00 AM PT (45 min)
- Thu, Feb 10 at 9:00 AM PT (45 min)

To help procurement move quickly, we can:
- Offer a time-limited pilot credit: $3,000 promotional credit for a 2-week technical pilot (applies if you sign PO by Feb 28)
- Provide a 15-minute pre-demo call focused on SOC2 artifacts and evidence — available the week of Feb 1 if helpful

I’ve attached a procurement checklist and the demo deck again for quick reference. If either slot works, I’ll send the calendar invite and include the pre-demo checklist as an attachment.

Thanks, and let me know which slot you prefer.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
